children: Shares of Hero Motors (HERT.NS) debuted 2.38% lower on Wednesday in pre-open trade after the Indian auto parts maker raised $104.2 million in its initial public offering.
The stock pre-opened at 82 rupees on the National Stock Exchange, compared with its IPO price of 84 rupees, giving the company a valuation of 37.25 billion rupees ($389.49 million).
